item.title: The American-made hemp shirt experiment
item.description: Hemp is often held up as a versatile crop with all sorts of applications.

item.title: ‘American Soul’ author explains how Black history shapes US cuisine
item.description: Former diplomat-turned-creator Anela Malik reflects on how Black foodways formed the backbone of the American food system.

item.title: Heat’s Herro content in reserve, ‘It doesn’t really feel like I’m out of place’
item.description: Nothing passive aggressive this time. Not amid the winning. Not with what's working. So Tyler Herro off the bench? Off to a good start, as the Heat reformulate amid health and hope.

item.title: South Florida temperatures to plunge. How long will the chill last?
item.description: Temperatures in South Florida will drop significantly beginning Sunday night, with low temperatures in the 40s that are expected to feel much colder due to a vigorous northwest wind. Tuesday will be the coldest morning this week, forecasters say.

item.title: Mexican army kills leader of powerful Jalisco New Generation Cartel during operation to capture him
item.description: The Mexican army killed the leader of the Jalisco New Generation Cartel, Nemesio Rubén Oseguera Cervantes, “El Mencho,” in an operation Sunday, a federal official said.

item.title: ‘It is definitely the redneck Olympics.’ Florida Man Games crowns its champ
item.description: This year's contest included fan-favorites like the evading police obstacle course and hurricane supplies grocery aisle brawl, as well as new Florida-based games involving cattle prods, bullwhips and fake deer urine.

item.title: As Dolphins scout draft prospects at combine, answers on offseason should come this week
item.description: The Dolphins will scout NFL draft prospects at virtually all positions at the combine this week, while more of their offseason plan takes shape.

item.title: 32nd annual Lake Worth Beach Street Painting Festival | PHOTOS
item.description: View photos from the Lake Worth Beach Street Painting Festival on Sunday, Feb. 22, 2026. See vibrant chalk art from over 800 artists in downtown Lake Worth Beach.

item.title: Pat Riley reflects on Showtime and its Heat impact as statue unveiled in Los Angeles
item.description: For Pat Riley, it was Showtime again on Sunday in Los Angeles. This time his own showtime, with his statue unveiled in front of the Lakers' Crypto.com Arena in downtown Los Angeles.
